trigger.description: Memory-drift collection fails before inspecting evidence for a non-contention reason, such as a missing or unsafe database path or a generic read-only report-build failure. This code is distinct from memory_drift_lock_contention and from memory_drift_source_unverifiable, which is reserved for inspected or structurally parsed evidence that cannot be verified.
setup_commands: inject a non-contention read-only memory-drift report failure before evidence inspection
